description: This Dart source file implements a service class 'OpenAIChatService' for communicating with OpenAI's Chat Completions API. It defines error handling, constructs API requests with chat messages, and processes responses to extract assistant content. It also includes related enums and exception classes for error management.

classes.name: ChatGPTError
classes.description: Enumeration representing different error types returned by the OpenAI API.

classes.name: ChatGPTException
classes.description: Exception class wrapping ChatGPTError, providing human-readable messages.

classes.name: OpenAIChatService
classes.description: Service class responsible for sending messages to and receiving responses from the OpenAI Chat API.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Public method that sends a list of chat messages to the OpenAI API and returns the assistant's reply as a string.
